assumptions: Exploratory bootstrap-vector entry; not measured architectural cold boot
Provisional R0-R12=0, SP=0, LR=0xfffffff0, CPSR=0x1d3 and CPU reset system-register state
Single-core diagnostic; other cores and release behavior unmodeled
Little-endian ARM state, MMU/caches disabled initially
RAM permissions and untouched tail zero allocation are hypotheses; original code performs its own BSS/stack clears
Synthetic exploration: explicit static full-word port samples, not physical camera state or a no-buttons condition. Configuration remains inferred; timer, IRQ, storage and calibration remain unknown.

Synthetic timer: channels initially halted; immediate count loading; preserve count on enable;54MHz virtual clock with1ns per instruction; stop at first terminal count, no reload or IRQ behavior established.
Virtual time follows executed instructions; synthetic timer deadlines do not drive idle warp. Debugger pauses do not advance this countdown. WFI wake/IRQ timing remains unsupported.
Synthetic platform:16 declared transfer-global words; only bit28 enable changes modeled, no transfer/status/IRQ.
Synthetic clock apply: known selection values, staged command2 and1ns virtual completion; logical latch only, no actual frequency change or measured ready/reset timing.
Named virtual MX25UM51245GXDI00 SPI-start boot-command subset; actual fitted camera part is unknown.
Synthetic controller reset words and dual-opcode-based early STIG SPI/OPI-DTR adapter; F0 bit4 is uninterpreted logical readback, not established physical semantics.

64ns logical transaction completion plus 40ns typical volatile CR2 settling; no measured timing or guaranteed maximum. Busy/idle, data and IRQ state follow pending operations. No array, indirect DMA, PHY training or CPU IRQ route.

Synthetic PHY digital handshake:initial observation0, immediate reset/disable lock clear,4ns master-ready and4ns DLL-lock transitions. No measured analog timing, passing taps or data-eye/calibration result.
Separate B4/B8/BC register authority and controller-config admission; no array mapping, request routing, DMA completion or CPU IRQ route supplied.
This profile adds only a strict covered128-byte flash-to-RAM calibration path. Earlier no-array/DMA statements describe the parent profiles. No direct CPU flash mapping or general DMA is supplied.
Virtual source translation subtracts F0000000 within64MiB capacity; unknown bytes reject. This is an integration policy, not documented physical high-bit masking.

Explicit ideal sampling for all taps0..127 in controller phases20/21; original code performs comparisons and chooses the calibration result. No measured data-eye or physical phase21 acceptance is claimed.
Explicit request2A/channel1, active-bit16 on peripheral request,64ns whole delivery and retained programmed addresses. No CPU IRQ, partial progress or measured DMA timing/status.
Virtual CBAR F8F00000 keeps the first unmodeled GIC access outside RAM; actual camera CBAR and GIC behavior remain unknown.
